ts-skip-to-content: Link at the very top of every page, visible on keyboard focus, that jumps past the header to the page's content.
ts-search-placeholder: Placeholder of the search box in the global header. Search covers entity labels, domain keys and page titles (ADR 0010 §3).
ts-search-label: Accessible label of the search box in the global header.
ts-search-button:
Label of the button beside the search box.
{{Identical|Search}}
ts-nav-label: Accessible name of the site navigation in the global header.
ts-nav-recentchanges:
Link in the global header to Special:RecentChanges.
{{Identical|Recent changes}}
ts-nav-jobs: Link in the global header to Special:Jobs, the list of import jobs (ADR 0010 §9).
ts-nav-specialpages:
Link in the global header to Special:SpecialPages.
{{Identical|Special pages}}
ts-new:
Label of the menu in the global header for creating items, properties and pages.
{{Identical|New}}
ts-new-item: Entry of the New menu that opens Special:NewItem.
ts-new-property: Entry of the New menu that opens Special:NewProperty.
ts-new-page: Entry of the New menu that creates a document page.
ts-login:
Link in the global header for a viewer who is not logged in.
{{Identical|Log in}}
ts-account: Link in the account menu to Special:Account, the account settings (ADR 0010 §11).
ts-account-menu:
Accessible name of the account menu button.

Parameters:
* $1 - the account's name
ts-account-userpage: Link in the account menu to the viewer's own user page.
ts-logout:
Link in the account menu that logs the viewer out.
{{Identical|Log out}}
ts-tabs-label: Accessible name of the row of tabs under a page's title.
ts-tab-read:
Tab under a page's title that shows the page.
{{Identical|Read}}
ts-tab-history:
Tab under a page's title that shows its history.
{{Identical|History}}
ts-not-served: Shown on a page the site does not serve yet, while the site is built phase by phase.
ts-not-found-title:
Title of the page shown for an address the site has no page for.
{{Identical|Not found}}
ts-not-found: Body of the page shown for an address the site has no page for.
ts-api-unavailable-title: Title of the page shown when the site cannot reach the API.
ts-api-unavailable: Body of the page shown when the site cannot reach the API.
ts-api-too-old: Body of the page shown when the API reports an older api_version than the site needs (ADR 0057 §9).
ts-footer-powered:
Footer line on every page.
"Triplespace" is the software's name and is not translated.
